_instructions.about: Add your conference abstracts, posters, and talks here. The page renders this automatically — no HTML edits needed.

fields.year: Year of presentation (number, used for grouping)
fields.title: Full title of the abstract or poster
fields.authors: Author list. Wrap your name in **double stars** to bold it, e.g. **John V**
fields.highlight: true = green left border (use for first-author or featured work)
fields.note: Optional extra context, e.g. 'First-author poster presentation'
fields.url: Optional link to the abstract or poster PDF — omit the field if not available
fields.doi: Optional DOI if the abstract was published in a journal; shown on the CV

data.title: From Base Pairs to Blood Type incorporating Machine Learning Program: High School Students Decode Their Own ABO Gene towards Privately-held Sequencing and AI in Biology
data.authors: **Vishal John**, Lucia Moscola, Ziqi Guo, Ava Dornseif, Cristina Castillo, Inhan Lee.
data.conference: American Society of Human Genetics (ASHG) 2026 Annual Meeting
data.note: First-author poster. High school students in miRcore's Sequencing Your Genome program built a machine-learning model that predicts blood type from their own ABO variants, correctly classifying 85% of participants it had never seen.
